come before speaking. Confidence comes
after speaking. Many people think they
need to feel confident first, but that's
not how it works. Number one, just
speak.
Don't overthink it. Many English
learners struggle with something called
analysis paralysis.
Try saying that three times in a row.
Analysis paralysis, analysis paralysis,
analysis paralysis. What this means is
they think too much and they freeze up.
By the way, freeze up is an excellent
phrasal verb, which means that you pause
and you don't do anything. They think
too much about grammar and they think
too much about mistakes. They also think
too much about sounding perfect. I know

how to do something with perfection, the
less time you are out there trying. So
because of analysis paralysis, they
